map.景深和什么有关？: What does depth of field depend on?
map.光圈越小、焦距越短、物距越远景深越大；光圈优先控制虚化最直接，f 值每加一档景深: The smaller the aperture, the shorter the focal length and the farther the subject distance, the greater the depth of field; aperture gives the most direct control over bokeh, and each full stop roughly doubles the depth of field.
